'''Pek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sedrian]] priest who gained powers similar to those of [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|users]] after he was exposed to the [[Golden Sun]]. Pek's father was [[High Priest/Legends|High Priest]] [[Cardo (Sedrian)|Cardo]].

==Biography==
Pek was the son of [[High Priest/Legends|High Priest]] [[Cardo (Sedrian)|Cardo]], and was a [[Priests of the Sun|priest]] and leader of the [[Sedrian]]s in his own right. As a young Sedrian, Pek shared a romance with [[Fala (Sedrian)|Fala]], daughter of [[Karak]]. As a [[Priest/Legends|priest]], Pek was dedicated to ensuring the [[Golden Sun]] shone forever, and preserving the culture and customs of his people.<ref name="BGS" />

When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] arrived on Sedri and began building their [[Imperial Aquatic Garrison|garrison]], and their efforts began killing the local sea life. Pek set out from Fitsay to scout the installation and managed to infiltrate the facility. On his way back to Fitsay, he was attacked by a number of Imperial [[Aquatic assault stormtrooper|seatroopers]] riding [[Waveskimmer/Legends|waveskimmers]]. While fighting them off, Pek was assisted by new arrivals who defeated the seatroopers. Although wary of the new arrivals, Pek learned that they were members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] and had arrived on Sedri with good intentions. He insisted on the Alliance [[Agent/Legends|agents]] accompanying him to Fitsay and meeting with his father.<ref name="BGS" />

After the Alliance agents met with Cardo and talked with him on a variety of subjects, Pek promised to lead them to the Imperial garrison the next [[Standard day/Legends|day]]. In the morning, Pek told them that his father had forbidden him to lead the Alliance team to the base, but he disagreed and decided to do what was right. Using his knowledge of the base layout, Pek helped the Alliance agents to infiltrate the garrison.<ref name="BGS" />

Pek joined the Alliance team in traveling to [[Karak's settlement|the renegade settlement]] to find the missing [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] [[Mors Odrion]] where he was reunited with Fala. The Alliance team managed to convince Fala that her father was in league with the Galactic Empire, which caused Fala and many of the renegades to recant their support for Karak. During the [[Battle of Fitsay]], Pek, Fala, and the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Rekara]] assisted the Golden Sun's chosen champion in defeating Karak and freeing the Golden Sun to spread across [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]]. Pek, alongside Fala, succeeded [[Cardo (Sedrian)|Cardo]] as High Priest.<ref name="BGS" />

==Personality and traits==
Pek was a friendly and curious Sedrian, and although he was dedicated to preserving the customs of his people, he was open to new ideas.<ref name="BGS" />
